inclusion_rule: EEG decoding studies that report accuracy on subjects whose data were not used to train the decoder (leave-one-subject-out, a fixed set of held-out subjects, or subject-independent cross-validation). Boundary: within-subject cross-validation only, fine-tuning on the test subject's labeled trials before scoring (counted, but recorded as calibrated transfer), and reviews are excluded; versions of one study count once.
